label: nyiso 91 ctstart control
definition: (PROBE) nyiso-91 CT start-frequency lane — zero-delta control (keeper config, no override); reproduces the keeper's dispatch exactly (2023 CC_REGULAR 32.513, CT_PEAKER 0.443/0.394/1.407 TWh). It carries the session's evidence rather than a mechanism: pricing every measured CT_PEAKER start the model does not make, on the model's own P1 LMP against the plant's own SRMC, leaves only 6-11% in merit and 81-85% deep out of merit (median -$13 to -$15/MWh) — and only 22-36% of the runs it never begins are profitable as whole BLOCKS at realized DA prices, so start-cost recovery over a day-ahead block is refuted too. NO ARM was registered: every mechanism that would reproduce the start count is refuted by that measurement or forbidden by the lane's guardrails. Write-up: docs/FINDING-nyiso91-ct-start-frequency-2026-07-27.md.
